ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** in a replay, tap a standing picture while a card lies over it, then again once the card has gone; then tap an earlier picture hidden under a later one. **Expect:** under the card the tap only holds the replay; once the card has gone the picture opens its moment; the hidden one gives the tap to the later picture (`replay-ceremony ui 15`: what takes a tap is `pointerEvents` sent in `setNativeProps`' style by `liveStyle.ts`, never a render; if a phone ignores it there, every picture takes taps always).
